name: Shanghai Iluvatar CoreX Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Iluvatar CoreX Semiconductor Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, and deployment of advanced GPGPU products and AI computing solutions in China. It offers various GPGPU chips and accelerators, along with its proprietary and full-stack software development kits, including performance-optimized libraries, AI training frameworks and inference engines, enabling powerful AI applications across training and inference scenarios. It primarily develops and sell GPGPU accelerators, the accelerators integrate GPGPU chips with memory modules, PCB, and other critical components, forming complete computing accelerators that are ready for direct application in the end computing systems.
